typedDecisionHelp: Off keeps every decision point on its deterministic path. A hosted provider also needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY on the server; switching takes effect within seconds, with no deploy.

features.confidenceHelp: Minimum confidence between 0 and 1. Lower answers keep the deterministic path.
features.invalidInteger: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
features.invalidSubmit: Fix the highlighted feature switch values before saving

media.heading: Perception
media.perceptionHelp: Workers extract frames, on-screen text, transcripts and a scene description from new media. Off stops the sweep from queueing assets.
media.brandVisualAnalysisHelp: Reads on-screen text and logo or product placement in branded images and video with a paid vision model. Off keeps those brand checks unknown and calls no provider.
media.brandVisionOcrModelHelp: Catalog model that reads on-screen text. Every read is recorded in the cost ledger at the price shown.
media.brandVisionDetectModelHelp: Catalog model that finds logo and product regions. Every read is recorded in the cost ledger at the price shown.
media.visionModelHelp: Leave empty to use the default fast text model.
media.visionGateHelp: Live sends flagged assets to review. Costs one vision call per perceived asset.
media.textGateHelp: Brand safety and on-brand checks over transcripts and scene descriptions. Needs a typed-decision provider.

moderation.heading: Moderation
moderation.providerHelp: None sends no media off the server. OpenAI needs OPENAI_API_KEY on the server.
moderation.modeHelp: Shadow stores scores and logs what would flag. Live sends flagged assets to review.
moderation.thresholdsHelp: Leave a category empty to keep its default. Lower is stricter.

decisions.shadowCappedHelp: Live is not available for this decision yet.
decisions.agentAutoRoutingHelp: Picks the chat model from the admin model registry. Shadow logs the pick without using it.

agent.heading: Behaviour
agent.contextCompressionHelp: Summarise older thread turns so long conversations fit the model context.
agent.tokenStreamingHelp: Stream model output token by token instead of simulated word chunks.

platform.heading: Accounts
platform.emailVerificationHelp: Email and password accounts must verify their address before signing in. Needs a working notifications service to send the email.
platform.emailVerificationUnavailable: Unavailable: no email provider is configured. Set RESEND_API_KEY on the notifications service to require email verification. Until then, sign-up and sign-in are never blocked, whatever this was set to before.
platform.systemEventsHelp: Records signup and billing events for operator alerts. Events before recording started are never replayed.

discord.channelsHelp: Channel IDs for operator updates. Leave one empty to skip it.

notifications.title: System notifications
notifications.description: Choose where new signup and billing notifications are sent. Destinations can be changed without a deploy. Provider credentials are configured on the server.
notifications.recordingDisabled: Recording is disabled. Turn on Record system events in the Accounts tab to receive new events.
notifications.deliveryDisabled: Delivery is disabled in system notification settings.
notifications.discordBotUnavailable: The Discord bot is not connected, so signup, studio and revenue alerts are not delivered. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN on the notifications service.
notifications.discordChannelsMissing: Discord alerts for these channels are skipped until a channel ID is set in the Discord settings: {channels}.
notifications.discordChannelTestsHelp: Posts a test message through the bot to the channel ID saved in the Discord channels settings. Save the settings first.
notifications.discordChannelTestSent: Test message posted to the {channel} channel
notifications.ready: Recording is enabled. Destinations receive the selected events.
notifications.label: Name
notifications.preserveWebhook: Leave blank to keep the saved webhook. Paste a replacement to change the server or channel.
notifications.webhookHelp: Create a webhook in the Discord channel you want to notify, then paste its URL.
notifications.telegramHelp: Add the configured Telegram bot to this chat and allow it to send messages.

saveHint: Saves every tab at once. Changes apply to every server within 15 seconds, with no deploy.
typedDecisionsHelp: Each decision below runs Off, Shadow or Live. Min confidence is 0 to 1; a lower answer keeps the deterministic path.
